title: Data package (v1) — one immutable delivery attempt
description: Spec 05a §T2.1/§T2.2. A carried document, not a ninth envelope type: it has no lifecycle of its own and enters the space through the handoff that carries it. Its id takes the exchange-broadcast shape (date + rand4), deliberately outside the X- namespace — every attempt is a new immutable document, never a standing artifact that accrues versions (plan D-1).

id.description: DP-<system>-<YYYYMMDD>-<rand4>. Not an X- prefix: XD- is already the live, closed prefix for `decision` (plan D-1) and a package minted with it would silently route as one.

thread.description: The same thread as the handoff that carries this package.

contract.description: The exact contract version this package was packed and verified against: <XC-id>@<version>#<digest>.

mode.description: snapshot only in this phase; live is reserved for the remainder (CONFIRM-5) and is deliberately not a member yet.

classification.description: Must satisfy the space's own policy.

data_profile.description: production is not a member: refused structurally here as well as by the pack-time refusal (§T2.4).

format.description: Closed set, extended by amendment only.

transport_driver.description: space-git is the only driver this phase ships.

locator.description: Driver-scoped; for space-git the package root relative to the space. The clean-relative-path shape structurally excludes a credential, a token or an absolute local path (no leading '/', no ':', no '@', no '\\').

aggregate_digest.description: Digest over the canonical entry set; what a verdict names.

size_bytes.description: Sum of entry sizes; bounded before fetch.

record_count.description: Producer's honest claim; the consumer re-counts and records both.

created_at.description: Producer clock; never a protocol ordering key.

expires_at.description: After this instant a fetch is refused.

attempt.description: 1 for the first delivery on this request; supersedes.attempt + 1 thereafter.

provenance.description: Sanitized source description: origin system, cursor/watermark, extraction time.

allOf.description: attempt and supersedes must agree: the first attempt on a request carries no supersedes, and every later attempt must name the one it replaces.

cleanRelativePath.description: Package-root-relative, contained, no traversal, no absolute path, no credential shape: a leading '/', a drive letter, '\\', ':' or '@' cannot match this pattern.

entry.description: Deliberately the same shape a contract's carried set already uses (§T2.2).

conforms_to.description: The contract schema entry this file is checked against. Required on dataset entries, and only those.

record_count.description: Per-file claim, required on dataset entries.
